Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; reviewed period printings; issue #741.

Cards.Name: Befriend the Tides
Cards.Text: Water Battle, Bow this card: Move this Shugenja from the current battlefield to an adjacent battlefield.

Cards.Name: Constructing the Self
Cards.Text: Air Limited, Bow this card: This Spell may remain bowed. Create a 0F Illusion • Nonhuman • Cavalry • Shugenja Personality with this Shugenja's Chi and Personal Honor. After the next time this game this Spell straightens or leaves play, remove the Illusion from the game.

Cards.Name: Koan's Whisper
Cards.Text: Void Limited, Bow this card: Reduce a Province's strength to 0. If its player has two or more Provinces, you may remove five Koan cards you control from the game to destroy it.
